When it comes to finances, Paimon's idea of a financial plan is secretly stashing Mora away in a piggy bank...

#### Go to the Zapolyarny Palace

**Paimon:** Your Majesty, we're here!

**Anastasya:** You two will be accompanying me to Northland Bank headquarters today.

**Paimon:** Northland Bank headquarters?

- **Traveler:** What for?

**Anastasya:** To go over some financial matters with Pantalone. He suggested I bring you along, saying your input might be needed in certain areas.

**Paimon:** Financial stuff? Paimon's idea of finance is just secretly stashing Mora away in a piggy bank...

##### Response branch 1

- **Traveler:** My approach isn't that different from Paimon's...

##### Response branch 2

- **Traveler:** I'm practically a finance whiz!

##### Shared continuation

**Anastasya:** You need only accompany me. Pantalone has his own proposal to present.

#### Head to the Northland Bank headquarters

**Regrator:** Your Majesty the Tsaritsa, and Your Excellency, please forgive me for not coming to greet you.

**Anastasya:** Pantalone. You may begin.

**Regrator:** Yes, Your Majesty. At present, Snezhnaya's treasury is running dry, and we find ourselves stretched thin whenever funds must be raised...

**Anastasya:** State your plan.

**Regrator:** ...Please take a look at this first, Your Majesty.

**Paimon:** Ooh, Paimon knows these! It's that kind of toy where you put a small doll inside a bigger doll. "Matryoshka dolls," right? They're so pretty, and tons of fun too!

**Paimon:** But this one doesn't have any of those pretty patterns painted on it yet.

**Regrator:** Your Majesty, I hope you might grant me the use of your likeness as the design for these dolls, to be issued and sold by Northland Bank.

**Regrator:** My projections indicate that, alongside our other financial measures, this venture would generate enough combined commercial revenue to cover the shortfall in tax receipts.

**Regrator:** Heh... Perhaps a modest surplus might even grace us with its presence.

**Paimon:** Making matryoshka dolls in the image of Her Majesty the Tsaritsa...

**Anastasya:** What is the basis for that estimate?

**Regrator:** The people of Snezhnaya's devotion to you, Your Majesty, goes without saying.

**Regrator:** Furthermore, I would also like our esteemed special envoy to create the designs to be painted. Your taste has already made quite an impression, Your Excellency.

**Regrator:** The portrait of Your Majesty that he released not long ago proved most popular. A shame that it was never commercialized. / The portrait of Your Majesty that she released not long ago proved most popular. A shame that it was never commercialized.

**Paimon:** Paimon remembers now... You still haven't given up on that, huh?

**Regrator:** Hehe... Well, Your Majesty, what are your thoughts?

**Anastasya:** Very well. Since you are confident this plan will resolve the crisis, I leave the arrangements to you.

**Regrator:** Thank you, Your Majesty. Next, I would like to ask our special envoy to personally design the paintwork for these matryoshka dolls.

**Anastasya:** Traveler, you may make your own judgments in this matter.

- **Traveler:** No problem. I'll handle it.

- **Traveler:** (That's perfect. Let's go with this!)

**Paimon:** Wow, this one's so cute... Hehe, little kids will definitely sleep soundly with this keeping them company, right?

**Regrator:** Impeccable taste, as one would expect of Your Excellency. I am sure these will sell very well.

**Anastasya:** As I said, I leave the remaining arrangements to your judgment.

**Regrator:** Thank you, Your Majesty. This batch of matryoshka dolls should hit the market soon. If Your Majesty and our honored envoy have a moment later, I would be delighted to welcome you back and report on their sales.

**Regrator:** With that, I shall go and make the necessary arrangements, Your Majesty.

**Paimon:** Paimon didn't expect you to actually allow him to use your image to make merchandise, Your Majesty...

**Anastasya:** Let him. If my likeness can help solve a problem, I see no reason to refuse him.

**Anastasya:** What matters is whether Pantalone's plan will work as swiftly as he claims.

##### Response branch 1

- **Traveler:** It should sell very well.

##### Response branch 2

- **Traveler:** Trust me.

##### Shared continuation

**Anastasya:** Mm. I am not questioning his plan. I have already approved it, and so I will not waver.

**Anastasya:** There is no need to trouble yourself too much with this matter either, Traveler. A decision has been made and someone has been entrusted with it; we need only wait for news.

##### Response branch 1

- **Traveler:** I'm still a little concerned...

##### Response branch 2

- **Traveler:** We're dealing with a ton of money, after all...

##### Shared continuation

**Anastasya:** A sense of responsibility is a good thing. However, if you personally concern yourself with every matter all of the time, no amount of strength will avail you.

**Anastasya:** Even the power to shake the world cannot solve every problem. In my view, what matters most is knowing how to exercise "judgment," and how to trust it.

**Anastasya:** And finally, having placed that "judgment" in the hands of another, one must also possess the magnanimity to accept what they do with it.

**Anastasya:** Traveler, you will face countless decisions as my councilor. You would do well to learn to adjust your way of thinking.

- **Traveler:** Got it.

**Anastasya:** Of course, as we originally agreed, we are partners. I would also like to hear your insights when the opportunity arises.

**Anastasya:** That is all for today. Return to the city with me.
